diagnosis.greedy_selection_metric: balanced_accuracy (Derm7pt train is 62% NEV; plain accuracy would bias selection toward the majority class)
diagnosis.rollback_rule: The final feature config is the BEST POINT ALONG THE GREEDY PATH (by the selection metric), not necessarily the state after the last step. The walk always applies whichever remaining lever helps most at each step, but a later step can still make things worse than an earlier one (see greedy_path); when that happens the earlier, better step is what final_config uses. A lever that hurts is therefore never silently locked in just because the walk reached it.

criteria.greedy_selection_metric: macro-averaged binary concept F1 across all 7 criteria (DermAgent protocol); SHARED across heads so there is one final feature config
criteria.rollback_rule: The final feature config is the BEST POINT ALONG THE GREEDY PATH (by the selection metric), not necessarily the state after the last step. The walk always applies whichever remaining lever helps most at each step, but a later step can still make things worse than an earlier one (see greedy_path); when that happens the earlier, better step is what final_config uses. A lever that hurts is therefore never silently locked in just because the walk reached it.

operating_point_policy.rule: argmax(posterior / per_class_weight); weight<1 boosts that class's rank. Grid-searched w_SK, w_MISC independently over {1.0,0.7,0.5,0.35,0.25,0.15} on VALID (posterior re-ranking only, no refitting). Chosen = max(recall_SK + recall_MISC) subject to balanced_accuracy staying within 0.02 of the unweighted argmax.

ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L1_clinic_second_view: Does NOT transfer to HAM10000 -- HAM ships only a single dermoscopic image per lesion, no paired clinical photo.
ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L2_metadata: Historically ~flat on HAM in prior v3 evaluation (age/sex/localization concat); expected to remain a small effect there, unlike the modest gain (if any) measured here on Derm7pt.
ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L3_TTA: Transfers directly -- horizontal-flip averaging only needs the image, works identically for HAM/BCN.
ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L4_head_sweep: Transfers directly -- the model-family comparison is dataset-agnostic.
ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L5_zero_shot_text_tower: Transfers if the class vocabulary is re-prompted for HAM's 7 classes (akiec/bcc/bkl/df/melanoma/nevus/vasc); prompts here are Derm7pt-specific (5-class) and are NOT reusable as-is.
ham_bcn_transfer_notes.L6_stacking: The G6 stacking machinery is Derm7pt-specific (reads Derm7ptCase); a HAM port would need an equivalent view-building step, not a straight reuse.

phase2_promotion_plan: Freeze the final diagnosis config (features + family + hyperparameters) and final criteria config exactly as recorded in this artifact's final_config blocks -- no re-tuning at promotion time.

If diagnosis features changed (e.g. +clinic concat or TTA), re-point medguard_v2/perception/probe.py's TARGETS['diagnosis'] fit to consume the new feature matrix, OR add a new probe module rather than editing the frozen one in place -- decide based on whether v1-vs-v2 comparability still matters at that point.

If the criteria final config changes the feature representation, medguard_v2/pipeline/run_cohort.py:fit_readers and medguard_v2/eval/gates/g1b_trained_criterion_heads.py both need the new feature matrix wired in; BASE_C=10.0 there would need to become the phase-1-selected C (or family) per head.

Re-run scripts/dev/build_test_metrics_complete.py after promotion so binary_concept_f1_macro and the DermAgent comparison row are re-derived on TEST under the new config -- this is the one-shot that actually tells us whether the valid-split gain measured here survives on the untouched split.

If L6's chosen view set changes, medguard_v2/eval/gates/g6_multiview_stacking.py's discover_feature_sets() should be pointed at (or merged with) features_phase1/ so the gate can see dermlip_tta/dermlip_clinic_tta -- currently deliberately invisible to it (see features.note above).
Re-run the full suite (`py -3.13 -m unittest discover -s medguard_v2/tests -q`, or venv_win's python if py -3.13 still lacks open_clip/torch parity) after any promotion edit.
